common.tagline: Helps you feel like yourself while your body changes.
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

welcome.title: Feel like yourself while your body changes.
welcome.intro: Interim shows you how you look today, and what to wear and how to style your hair for the days ahead. It is made for anyone going through a change, including the changes that come with illness.
welcome.reassurance: You choose what to share, and you can delete everything at any time.
welcome.footnote: Interim is about how you look and what to wear. It does not give medical advice.

language.title: Choose your language
language.intro: Interim will use it for everything you read.

situation.title: What is changing for you?
situation.intro: Choose the one that fits best. You never need to name a condition or a medicine.
situation.groupIllness: Often part of illness or its care

blurbs.hair_loss_ahead: Your hair is thinning, or you expect it to. Plan for each stage, from thinning to growing back.
blurbs.hair_patches: Hair is coming out in patches, and it may come and go.
blurbs.face_fullness: Your face looks fuller or different, and it may settle again.
blurbs.after_surgery: Your body has a new shape. Fit and comfort come first, and body photos stay off until you turn them on.
blurbs.skin_colour: Your skin tone is shifting, and colours that used to suit you may not now.
blurbs.weight_change: Your weight is going up or down, on purpose or not, and your clothes sizes are changing.
blurbs.midlife_change: Changes in your hair and body through midlife. Volume and cut matter most.
blurbs.after_a_baby: Hair shedding after having a baby. Interim steers you away from big cuts for now.
blurbs.going_grey: Growing out your grey in stages, instead of dyeing it.
blurbs.textured_growth: Growing out textured hair, from very short to shoulder length.
blurbs.beard_growth: Growing a beard, from stubble to full.

setup.title: A few things about you
setup.intro: These shape how Interim talks to you and what it shows.
setup.toneTitle: How should Interim talk to you?

practical.label: Just practical
practical.description: What changed and one thing to do. No talk about feelings.

warm.label: Warm
warm.description: Kind and steady, with a short note at the start of each check in.

setup.headCoveringHelp: If you do, Interim will not show hairstyles or wigs on your photos.

consent.title: Before you add photos
consent.intro: Your photos, and what Interim learns from them, are personal. Here is exactly what happens to them.
consent.keepBody: Your photos, the measurements taken from them, your answers, your cards and the reflections you write. Nothing is sold or used for advertising.
consent.helperYoucam: YouCam, by Perfect Corp, receives your photos so it can measure them and preview looks.
consent.helperGoogle: Google receives measurements, your situation, what you are getting ready for and the tone you chose, so it can write your notes. If a reflection you write may show you are having a hard time, Google also reads that text, and nothing else about you, only to check on it. It never receives photos.
consent.retentionTitle: How long to keep your photos

standard.label: Delete after 30 days
standard.description: Photos and previews are deleted 30 days after they are taken. Measurements and cards stay until you delete your profile.

extended.label: Keep my history
extended.description: Keep them until you delete them, or until 24 months after your last check in. This lets Interim compare over time and show earlier looks.

consent.confirmStore: Interim may store my photos and measurements.
consent.confirmYoucam: YouCam (Perfect Corp) may process my photos.
consent.confirmGoogle: Google may process my measurements and settings, and a reflection I write if it may show I am having a hard time, but not my photos.
consent.confirmOwn: The photos will only be of me.
consent.confirmAll: I agree to all of the above.
consent.deleteAnytime: You can delete your profile and everything in it at any time.
consent.outdated: The consent text has changed. Reload this page and read it again.

ready.title: You are set up
ready.intro: Interim has what it needs to start.
ready.next: Your check in is a few photos and a few quick questions.
ready.deleteBody: This removes your profile, photos, measurements and cards. It cannot be undone.
ready.exportBody: A zip file with your profile, check ins, reflections and the renders that are still stored.

reflect.title: Reflection
reflect.intro: Only if you feel like it. What you write is saved to your account, is never shown to anyone else, and you can delete it any time.
reflect.prompt: What would you say to a friend going through this?
reflect.tooMany: You have written a lot today. Please come back tomorrow.
reflect.offerBody: If you feel like it, you can put a few words on how this feels. It is only for you.
reflect.contactsIntro: If things feel very heavy, these services will listen, any time. You do not need to be sure it is a crisis.

auth.signInIntro: Welcome back. Your profiles are waiting.
auth.signUpIntro: An account keeps your profiles safe and lets you open them on any device.
auth.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. A few words you will remember work well.
auth.privacy: Your email is used only to sign you in. Brevo sends our emails, and Google signs you in if you choose it. Neither receives your photos.
auth.invalid: That email and password do not match.
auth.unverified: Please confirm your email first. Open the link we sent, or ask for a sign-in link instead.
auth.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign in did not work. Please try again or use another way.
auth.magicIntro: Enter your email and we will send a link that signs you in. No password needed.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we will send a link to choose a new one.
auth.resetIntro: Pick a password you do not use anywhere else.
auth.checkVerify: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your email.
auth.checkMagic: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
auth.checkReset: If {email} has an account, we sent a link to choose a new password. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.
auth.checkSpam: Not there? Look in your spam folder.
auth.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.

account.title: Your account
account.passwordSet: You sign in with a password. You can choose a new one by email.
account.passwordNone: You have no password. You can sign in with a link or Google, or choose a password by email.
account.deleteBody: This deletes your account and every profile in it, with all photos, measurements and cards. It cannot be undone.

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Interim
verify.intro: Confirm your email to finish creating your Interim account.

magic.subject: Your Interim sign-in link
magic.intro: Use this link to sign in to Interim. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.

reset.subject: Choose a new Interim password
reset.intro: Use this link to choose a new password. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.

exists.subject: You already have an Interim account
exists.intro: Someone used this email to create an Interim account, but you already have one. You can sign in below.

email.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

settings.title: Your choices
settings.intro: Change how Interim talks to you, or whether it shows hair. You can change these any time.

companionFallback.practical: Here’s what changed since last time, and a few options for what’s coming up.
companionFallback.warm: Things look a little different this time, and that’s a normal part of this stage. Here are a few looks that still feel like you, for whatever is coming up.
companionFallback.light: New check in, new options. Here are a few looks to try for what’s coming up.

back_to_work: I’ve had some changes this year. I’m glad to be back.
Thanks for asking. I’d rather talk about work today.
It’s a long story. What did I miss?
family_event: Yes, my hair’s different. It’s so good to see you.
I’ll tell you about it another time. How have you been?
date: Things have changed for me lately. I’m happy to talk about it another time.
I’d rather hear about you first.
photos: Can we take one more? I want to pick my favourite.
Can I see it before it goes up?
video_call: New look this month. Shall we get started?
going_out: It’s a change I’m still getting used to. Anyway, what are we having?
I’d rather not get into it today.

capture.title: Your photos
capture.intro: A few photos and a few quick questions. Only you should be in the photos.
capture.reviewIntro: Look them over. Retake any you are not happy with, then send.

front.title: Front
front.help: Look straight at the camera in an even light, with your face in the middle.

right.title: Right side
right.help: Turn your head to the right so the camera sees the side.

left.title: Left side
left.help: Turn your head to the left so the camera sees the side.

top.title: Top of your head
top.help: Lower your head so the camera sees the top. The camera counts down for five seconds, or ask someone to take it.

body.title: Body
body.help: Stand back so your chest and waist show, in clothes you would like to try.

capture.cameraAllAction: Open the camera for the front and both sides
capture.skipHelp: Hair density is not measured without it.
capture.cameraBlocked: The camera is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or choose a photo instead.
capture.cameraUnavailable: The camera guide could not start. Choose a photo instead.
capture.changedTitle: Has anything changed since last time?
capture.sizeHelp: Pick the size you wear today.
capture.momentHelp: Optional. It helps the note fit your day.

photoProblems.duplicate_kind: Send one photo of each kind.
photoProblems.sides_baseline_only: The side photos are only needed for the first set.
photoProblems.body_photos_off: Body photos are off. Turn them on in your choices to add one.
photoProblems.baseline_has_report: The first set does not need these answers.
photoProblems.needs_change_answer: Tell us whether anything has changed since last time.
photoProblems.wrong_format: Use a JPEG, PNG or HEIC photo.
photoProblems.too_large: Photos can be up to 12 MB. Choose a smaller one.
photoProblems.not_uploaded: That photo did not upload. Try again.
photoProblems.unreadable: We could not read this photo. Try taking it again.
photoProblems.too_small: This photo is too small. Take it again a little closer.
photoProblems.too_dark: It is a little dark. Face a window or a lamp and try again.
photoProblems.too_bright: It is very bright. Move out of direct light and try again.
photoProblems.blurry: It looks blurred. Hold still, or clean the lens, and try again.
photoProblems.retake_angle: Check the angle of your head, then take it again.
photoProblems.retake_light: The light was not even. Face a window or a lamp and take it again.
photoProblems.retake_no_face: We could not see your face. Keep it in the middle of the frame and take it again.
photoProblems.retake_framing: Keep your face in the frame, with no one else, and take it again.
photoProblems.retake_other: This photo could not be used. Please take a new one.

run.intro: Interim is looking at your photos. This usually takes a minute or two.
run.failedError: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a little while.
run.failedNotRecorded: This demo has no recorded answer for these photos yet.
run.failedRetake: One photo needs to be taken again.

trace.placed_reported: Placed you from what you told us.

card.title: Your Stage Card
card.optionsIntro: These are previews of how a look could appear. They do not promise a result.
card.photoAlt: Your photo from this check in
card.imageGone: The image for this look is no longer stored.
card.professionalLine: For questions about your health, talk to a doctor or nurse.
card.clothesIntro: Previews of the pieces you saved, shown on your photo from this check in. A preview does not promise how a piece will fit.
card.clothesEmpty: Save some clothes and they will show here at your next check in.
card.shoppingIntro: Sizes come from the size you told us and each shop’s size chart, not from the previews.

holdReasons.size_moving: Your size is still settling, so wait before buying a fitted piece.
holdReasons.size_unknown: Tell us your size at your next check in and we will size it.
holdReasons.size_not_offered: The shop does not make it in your size.

clothes.title: Clothes to try on
clothes.intro: Save the pieces you are thinking about. At each check in they are shown on your photo, with a size from the shop’s size chart.

advice.patches_part: Try a parting in a new place. Hair falls differently from a new line, and a few tries show which one you like.
advice.patches_brow: A soft brow colour gives your face a finished look. Try the previews below.
advice.patches_volume: A volume preview shows a fuller look for your next photo. It is a preview, not a promise.
advice.patches_own_report: The hair density reading was not clear this time, so this stage comes from what you told us.
advice.fullness_neckline: Try a neckline that opens at the collar, such as a V or a scoop, and compare it with a crew neck.
advice.fullness_collar: Collars and fitted shirts can wait until your size settles. Soft collars work in the meantime.
advice.fullness_frame: If you wear glasses, try a few frames about as wide as your face and pick the pair that feels like you.
advice.surgery_soft: Start with soft fabrics, loose cuts and seams that sit away from anywhere that feels sensitive.
advice.surgery_front_opening: Pieces that open at the front are easy to put on and take off.
advice.surgery_relaxed_first: Relaxed pieces work well today. Fitted ones can wait until your shape settles.
advice.surgery_settled: Your shape has settled, so fitted pieces in the size you told us are fine to buy.
advice.surgery_photos_off: Body photos are off, so clothes are not shown on you. You can turn them on in settings whenever you like.
advice.skin_match_clothes: These clothing colours sit well with your skin colour reading. Hold them near your face to compare.
advice.skin_match_makeup: Makeup shades close to these suit the same reading. Compare them in daylight.
advice.skin_match_recheck: Your colour is still changing, so check shades again at each check in before you buy a lot.
advice.skin_match_unmeasured: There is no clear skin colour reading yet, so there are no colours to suggest. Take a front photo in even daylight at your next check in.

share.title: Share this card
share.note: Make a link for a stylist, barber or friend. They see the previews and the shopping list, never your photos, name or email. The link stops working on its own, and you can stop it any time.
share.viewIntro: Previews of looks and a shopping list, shared by the person they are for. A preview does not promise a result.
share.viewEmpty: There is nothing to show on this link.
